text: XXXX provided a copy of my credit report to multiple companies without my authorization : XXXX XXXX on XX/XX/XXXX -Ally Financial on XX/XX/XXXX -Bank of America on XX/XX/XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX on XX/XX/XXXX As such, it is a very serious error in reporting.
